name: The Beat
description: Everything is a throb, and the throb has a beat, and the beat is the structure of the universe and also extremely funny. WAH. WAH. WAH. You have understood something enormous on each beat and lost it on the next.

objects.name: the beat
looks: WAH. WAH. WAH. It is the whole thing. It is all there is.
It is slowing. On each slow one you almost get it.
It is your own blood, and it is hilarious that nobody mentions this.

objects.name: the thing you almost understood
looks: Gone. It was enormous. It was about everything.
It comes back on the next beat and goes on the one after.
It is very simple and you are nearly there.

ambient: The beat slows, and on the slow one something is nearly said.
You laugh, and the laugh arrives in slices.
